FIELDS.NAME: PrintRight Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At PrintRight Solutions, we offer comprehensive printing and copying services tailored to meet the diverse needs of our clients. Our operations are centered around providing high-quality digital and offset printing solutions, as well as document copying and finishing services. We utilize modern, well-maintained equipment, ensuring efficient production processes while minimizing the risk of breakdowns. Our workflow management emphasizes thorough training for employees on safety protocols and the proper handling of materials, fostering a safe working environment. We also adhere strictly to environmental regulations, managing any hazardous materials responsibly and maintaining meticulous documentation of our compliance practices. Our commitment to continuous improvement is reflected in our regular maintenance checks, business continuity planning, and investment in cybersecurity measures for our online operations. Operating from our fully equipped facility in Springfield, IL, we prioritize customer satisfaction through reliable service and exceptional quality in every project we undertake.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not operate any equipment older than 15 years and confirms that all necessary maintenance records are diligently maintained. We do not accept online orders or store customer data electronically, ensuring no need for cyber liability coverage. Additionally, we maintain comprehensive documentation of employee training on hazardous material handling and equipment use, while also ensuring adequate ventilation and providing all necessary personal protective equipment for employees working with inks, solvents, and other hazardous materials.
